results.name: D1 start daily: date, deterministic seed, depth 0, fresh battle, chip shown
D2 determinism: same date -> identical run in independent context; other date differs
D3 local-date handling: same instant gives each timezone its own local date
D4 save/resume: daily run mid-battle survives reload and resumes identically
D5 date rollover: yesterday's daily resumes after midnight; next daily uses new date
D6 daily defeat: result recorded, overlay, replay label, normal record untouched
D7 daily victory (fixture: final battle, foe at 1 hp): victory, recorded, normal record untouched
D8 restart during daily retries the same daily; New run returns to a normal run
D9 fail-closed: tampered daily save (wrong seed) is rejected, app starts a clean normal run
